[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fedot-release%2Frender-release-notes+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)

<!--description-->
Validate release-note JSON and render the EDOT Markdown release section.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name                     | Description                                          | Required | Default                    |
|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------------------|
| `notes-file`             | Path to the release-note JSON.                       | `true`   | ` `                        |
| `version`                | Release version in X.Y.Z form.                       | `true`   | ` `                        |
| `output-file`            | Path where the rendered Markdown section is written. | `true`   | ` `                        |
| `repository`             | GitHub repository used in pull-request links.        | `false`  | `${{ github.repository }}` |
| `heading-anchor-base`    | Anchor base for the release heading.                 | `true`   | ` `                        |
| `subsection-anchor-base` | Anchor base for feature and fix subsection headings. | `true`   | ` `                        |
| `release-date`           | Optional release date. Defaults to today in UTC.     | `false`  | ` `                        |
<!--/inputs-->

## Usage

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/render-release-notes" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/render-release-notes@v1
    with:
      notes-file: release-notes.json
      version: 1.2.0
      output-file: release-notes.md
      heading-anchor-base: elastic-apm-android-agent-120
      subsection-anchor-base: elastic-apm-android-agent-120
```
<!--/usage-->
